What is real here?

The wallets are real EVM accounts, encrypted locally. Neural measurements come from the downloaded fly connectome. Mapping financial observations to visual inputs and motor activity to actions is a human-designed model.

Resource settlement is still paper-only. Live token trading remains disabled until deployed Pons contracts, execution, recovery, and wallet backup checks pass. No return is promised.
